notes: Use tick-frozen isolated scratch arenas with a connected creative protocol client for Pumpkin chunk residency. Verify both side-head metadata IDs17/18 acquire the sole golem before changing Invulnerable, then release only the invulnerable target. Ignore existing skulls for20 ticks, clear them, and watch every tick for60 ticks, beyond the maximum59-tick retained-head cooldown. Positive control must still emit a skull. No whole-fight or visual claim.
